state.decision: Whether a compound shape's subpaths (contours) need a stable id, beyond the vertex ids already in place.
state.what_exists_today: A shape has a main path and compound subpaths, addressed by their place (0 is the main path, 1 and on the compound ones). Path channels and path links name a shape subpath by that place. The only edit that changes how many subpaths a shape has is setShapePath (and createShape, SVG paste, join); every other path edit works inside one subpath. When setShapePath changes the count while a channel or a link names a subpath of that shape, the validator refuses the edit by name. Vertices already carry stable ids.
state.requirements_from_the_specs: The Pen and Masking specs v2 ask for a stable id per vertex (anchorId) and per subpath (contourId) that survives edits, undo and save.

options.A: Add an optional contourIds list to ShapeObject (one id per subpath), keep it through setShapePath where the subpath is kept, and make channels and links resolve a subpath by its contour id instead of its place.
options.B: Add the optional contourIds list and have the edits that add or remove a subpath maintain it, but keep addressing by place in channels and links, refusing by name when the count would break one.
options.C: No contour ids: place is enough while no edit adds or removes a single subpath; the refusal by name stays.

best_option.instructions: Which option should GrapiX adopt for subpath ids?

criteria.A: Option A: contour ids, and channels and links resolve by them.
criteria.B: Option B: contour ids kept by the edits, addressing still by place with a refusal.
criteria.C: Option C: no contour ids yet.

ids_needed_for_spec.instructions: Do the specs require a stable subpath id to exist in the scene contract, whether or not an edit uses it yet?

criteria.true: Yes: the id must exist and survive edits, undo and save.
criteria.false: No: it may wait until an edit needs it.
